title: The 1-Second Test to Expose Fake AI Callers

vo.en: Say this word to spot fake callers!

visual.description: Male hand holding a glowing smartphone ringing in a dimly lit dark neon room.

vo.en: AI voice clones can now mimic your family's exact voice in real time.

vo.en: When a suspect caller asks for help, interrupt them mid-sentence with a random word like 'Pineapple'.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part most people miss.

vo.en: Human brains overlap speech instantly. But AI live-translators stutter and drop audio trying to process unexpected interruptions.

visual.description: Macro shot of sand trickling through an hourglass next to a glowing microchip circuit.

vo.en: If they freeze for even one second, hang up immediately.

vo.en: Subscribe for daily AI safety hacks, and comment your secret family code word below! Always test suspicious callers, so the moment your phone rings...
